examples.name: Sample — a diagonal stamp across a pay stub
paragraphs: THIS IS NOT A CHECK printed diagonally across the cheque-shaped lower half of an earnings statement, with NON–NEGOTIABLE beneath it. Both cross printed text; neither enters the lines they cross.

examples.name: Sample — a watermark across a form grid
paragraphs: Sample in large grey letters diagonally across a mostly empty project grid, crossing cells that hold checkbox lists. Same placement: once, out of the grid, at the top of the page.
